notes.production_path_definition: design §0: production = live rebuilt L1–L3 + the legacy chord competition (analyzeChord/applyHarmonicFunction) + the post-scoring correction block (applyPostScoringGates). Production call sites for the chord competition + gates: regionanalyzer.cpp Pass 1/2/2b, harmonicsegmenter.cpp, the notation bridges, inferNextRootPc() (scoring_model.md §6).
notes.dormant_chain_definition: design §0: dormant chain = rebuilt L1→L2→L3→L4-decoder→L5 (default-off). L4 decoder = chordslicedecoder.cpp (SliceChordDecoder); L5 = functionresolver / forwardoverride / functionoutput; VL/axis-2 = textureclassifier (DORMANT).
notes.D9_shared_constant_finding: The dormant L4 SliceChordDecoder REUSES the legacy scorer: chordslicedecoder.cpp:453 calls analyzer.analyzeChord(...) with the same ChordAnalyzerPreferences. Therefore every analyzeChord/applyHarmonicFunction scoring constant is on BOTH paths' fit surface (design D-9). Caveat (harness-phase, not Phase-0): the decoder invokes analyzeChord on a reduced/null temporal context (chordslicedecoder.cpp:46 comment 'the null-context path (no rootContinuity...)'), so the FIRING of the progression/temporal signals is attenuated on the dormant path even though the constants are read on both. The post-scoring gates run production-only (no applyPostScoringGates call in chordslicedecoder.cpp; the decoder projects analyzeChord's raw ranked results — chordslicedecoder.cpp:429/448/492).
notes.style_scope_caveat: The style_scope column is the design's DECLARED HYPOTHESIS at inventory time (§4.1). The §4.4a style-response measurement replaces it with a measured structure (invariant / discrete table / continuous) wherever strata exist; a 'style-invariant' parameter whose per-stratum optima diverge is a flagged finding. Textural-evidence families (inversion/bass/pedal) have axis-2 texture (cross-ARI 0.030), not the harmonic idiom, as their plausible coordinate (design D-11 iv).
notes.preset_varying_fields_at_source: Only these ChordAnalyzerPreferences fields are overridden per preset in tools/batch_analyze.cpp (main(), preset builder ~lines 3843-3898): extensionThreshold (Jazz 0.12 @3874), preferMinorOverMajorAdd6 (Baroque/Standard true @3883/3896; Jazz/Default false), stepwiseBassInversionBonus (Jazz 0.20 @3877), stepwiseBassLookaheadBonus (Jazz 0.20 @3878), sameRootInversionBonus (Jazz 0.15 @3879), completeTriadInversionBonus (Jazz 0.20 @3880). Every other field inherits the analysistypes.h struct default on all presets (Default overrides NONE).
notes.optimizer_bounds_table: analysistypes.h ChordAnalyzerPreferences::bounds() (:425-448) already declares optimizer ranges for 19 prefs fields — the existing optimizer-target set. The file-level static constexpr constants (kContradictionPenalty ... kWComplete) and the harmonicfunctionlayer.h progression constants are NOT in bounds() and are not currently preset-configurable (hardcoded) — a Phase-0 finding: they are fit candidates but have no runtime override surface today (the D-6 override plumbing is Phase-1 work).
notes.license_and_sensitivity_deferred: license_provenance is null on every row (design §7: filled at the first fitted value with which pool/split shaped it). sensitivity is null on every row (design §4.3: measured by the Phase-1b screen through the harness, which does not exist yet).
